method: BASELINE. Seat-neutral core in Article IV's own terms (pa-hsc.l4), with an applicant/recipient seat layer (pa-hsc-seat.l4) that calls it and restates no rule; the duty to meet the work requirements once a disability exemption ends (s 405.1(a.4)(1)) and the duty to report changes (s 432.14(b)) are regulative MUST rules, the right to a fair hearing within the timely notice period (s 423(a)) a MAY; written straight from the deposited text with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE, nothing outside the encoding is reachable from a question; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Human Services Code (Act of Jun. 13, 1967, P.L. 31, No. 21) as served by palegis.us on 2026-10-24, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/pa-1967-act-21-human-services-code.txt; Article IV at lines 1299-5284. No regulation brought in: the payment standards (55 Pa. Code ch. 175) are not deposited, so grant amounts are not computed; the combined SSI-plus-supplement amount and the state maximums are inputs.
